title: Aerial-R1: Reinforcing Aerial Reasoning and Segmentation in MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.33056v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have revolutionized general visual perception, existing methods suffer from severe hallucination in the aerial domain, where extreme scale variations and visual ambiguity abound. Existing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) paradigms force models to mimic ground truth without modeling uncertainty, often resulting in blind guessing on tiny or unrecognizable objects in aerial scenes. In this paper, we present Aerial-R1, the first aerial MLLM framework to reinforce visual reasoning capabilities for aerial reasoning and segmentation. Drawing inspiration from the reasoning-incentivizing mechanisms of DeepSeek-R1, we find that trustworthy perception stems from consistency across views, establishing a visual parallel to the Chain-of-Thought in logic. To effectively adapt policy optimization for non-autoregressive mask generation, we introduce Hybrid-View Group Advantage-Weighted Regression (H-GAWR). Thi

translated_title: Aerial-R1：通过强化学习增强多模态大语言模型的航拍推理与分割能力
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已经彻底改变了通用视觉感知，但现有方法在航拍领域存在严重的幻觉问题，因为航拍场景中充满了极端的尺度变化和视觉模糊性。现有的监督微调（SFT）范式迫使模型模仿真实标签而不建模不确定性，这常常导致模型在航拍场景中对微小或难以识别的物体进行盲目猜测。在本文中，我们提出了Aerial-R1，这是第一个用于增强航拍推理与分割视觉推理能力的航拍多模态大语言模型框架。受DeepSeek-R1推理激励机制的启发，我们发现可信的感知源于跨视角的一致性，这为逻辑推理中的思维链建立了视觉上的对应物。为了有效地将策略优化适配到非自回归掩码生成任务中，我们引入了混合视角组优势加权回归（Hybrid-View Group Advantage-Weighted Regression, H-GAWR）方法。
tldr: 提出首个航拍多模态大语言模型框架Aerial-R1，受DeepSeek-R1启发通过跨视角一致性机制增强视觉推理，并引入H-GAWR方法将策略优化适配到非自回归掩码生成，从而有效解决航拍场景中的幻觉问题并提升推理与分割能力。
en_tdlr: Aerial-R1 is the first aerial MLLM framework that reinforces visual reasoning for aerial reasoning and segmentation, inspired by DeepSeek-R1's reasoning-incentivizing mechanisms, leveraging cross-view consistency and introducing H-GAWR to adapt policy optimization for non-autoregressive mask generation.
